topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I can't believe it. Of all the teachers at this school, it had to be him. The same man who made my life a living hell years ago, now entrusted with my child's education. I remember every slight, every unfair grade, and the way he dismissed my concerns as if they were nothing. Now, he'll be the one to decide if my kid is good enough. This is absurd. There's no way I'm letting this slide. I've got to protect my child from the same nonsense I endured. I need to find a way to make sure history doesn't repeat itself.
